{{Quote|Are you positive the shuttle can get us through, Princess?"<br />"No problem, Lt. Falltower. Its shields aren't as heavy as those on this station&mdash;but they were designed to pass through the corona and back before requiring recharging."<br />"That's good to hear.|Falltower and Leia Organa|<ref name="marvel58" />}}
[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Falltower''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Falltower was posted to [[Haven Base]] on [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]] when the Alliance ran a novel experiment of concealing its [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]] within the chromosphere of the [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Arbran]], by way of five [[Kerts-Bhrg field generator|Kerts-Bhrg generators]]. Falltower was present with the fleet when the protective field was activated, and afterward he was among the retinue that accompanied [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] through the star and back to the base.<ref name="marvel58" />

==Behind the scenes==
Falltower appeared in [[Star Wars (1977) 58|''Star Wars'' 58]], written by [[David Michelinie]], illustrated by [[Walter Simonson]] and released in [[1982]].<ref name="marvel58" />
